description: This Java class defines an event named SubscriptionComplete within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It models an event emitted after completing all pages of a search subscription, including methods for creation, JSON deserialization, and managing event metadata.

classes.name: SubscriptionComplete
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the completion of a search subscription in the Ditto framework, including methods for instantiation from parameters and JSON, and for event handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionComplete instance with the specified subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SubscriptionComplete event from a JSON object and headers, deserializing the JSON content.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path for the event, which is empty in this case.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new SubscriptionComplete event with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds properties to the JSON payload; in this implementation, nothing is added.
